notes: Use a contactless card on the MRT. The city is small, and a taxi (Grab) costs 10-20 SGD. The MRT to Changi takes 45 minutes.
Return your tray at hawker centres (there are fines). Reserving a table with a tissue packet ('chope') is a local custom; a meal costs 5-8 SGD.
Summer (June-September) is relatively dry at 32°C; afternoon downpours are possible.
Chewing gum is banned, and littering and smoking are fined; supermarkets do not sell alcohol after 22:30.
Universal Studios and Cloud Forest tickets are cheaper online; some museums close on Mondays.
No tipping; a 10% service charge and 9% GST are added.

transit.name: EZ-Link / contactless card
transit.why_chosen: Works on the MRT and buses; a contactless bank card does the same job

days.theme: Marina Bay and Gardens by the Bay

stops.name: Gardens by the Bay Cloud Forest
stops.tips: Combined Cloud Forest + Flower Dome ticket (~46 SGD). Go in at the 09:00 opening for the indoor waterfall and cooler air.

stops.name: Supertree Grove
stops.tips: Giant metal trees; the OCBC Skyway (14 SGD) is optional.

stops.name: Satay by the Bay
stops.tips: The gardens' hawker centre: satay and chilli crab with bay views.

stops.name: Marina Bay Sands SkyPark
stops.tips: Observation deck on the 57th floor. Book a sunset slot; the pool is for hotel guests only.

stops.name: Spectra Light Show
stops.tips: Water and light show in front of Marina Bay Sands at 20:00 and 21:00, free. The Supertree Garden Rhapsody also runs at 19:45 and 20:45.

backups.name: Lau Pa Sat
backups.tips: Victorian-era hawker centre; Satay Street sets up in the evening.

backups.name: ArtScience Museum
backups.tips: Lotus-shaped museum with the Future World exhibition, a good rainy-day option.

stops.name: Buddha Tooth Relic Temple
stops.tips: Tang-style temple with a roof garden and prayer wheel, free entry.

stops.name: Chinatown Heritage Centre
stops.tips: Immigrant life inside a shophouse; small but moving.

stops.name: Maxwell Food Centre
stops.tips: Tian Tian Hainanese Chicken Rice: join the queue at 11:30, 5 SGD.

stops.name: Ann Siang Hill
stops.tips: Restored shophouses and cafes; Club Street is close by.

stops.name: Tiong Bahru
stops.tips: Art deco housing blocks. Try the croissants at Tiong Bahru Bakery and browse the bookshop BooksActually.

backups.name: Tiong Bahru Market
backups.tips: Local hawker centre; try chwee kueh (steamed rice cakes) and lor mee (noodles in thick gravy).

backups.name: Sri Mariamman Temple
backups.tips: The oldest Hindu temple in Singapore, in Chinatown.

stops.name: Universal Studios Singapore
stops.tips: Full-day theme park (~83 SGD). Arrive at opening for Transformers and Battlestar; an express pass is worth it in the crowds.

stops.name: Malaysian Food Street RWS
stops.tips: Hawker food on Sentosa; you can eat here after leaving the park.

stops.name: Siloso Beach
stops.tips: Sentosa's lively beach with warm water and a sunset bar.

stops.name: Wings of Time
stops.tips: Water and light show on Siloso Beach; catch the 19:40 showing.

backups.name: S.E.A. Aquarium
backups.tips: Huge aquarium, a calmer alternative to Universal Studios.

stops.name: Sri Veeramakaliamman Temple
stops.tips: Colourful Hindu temple on Serangoon Road; morning prayers.

stops.name: Tekka Centre
stops.tips: Little India's market and hawker centre; have roti prata (flatbread) and teh tarik (pulled milk tea) for breakfast.

stops.name: Mustafa Centre
stops.tips: Giant department store open 24 hours; it has everything.

stops.name: Sultan Mosque
stops.tips: Kampong Glam's golden-domed mosque; outside visiting hours, admire it from outside.

stops.name: Haji Lane
stops.tips: Narrow graffiti-covered lane with boutiques and cafes; the fabric shops of Arab Street are nearby.

backups.name: Zam Zam Restaurant
backups.tips: Serving murtabak (stuffed pan-fried bread) since 1908, opposite the Sultan Mosque.

backups.name: Malay Heritage Centre
backups.tips: Former palace with Malay history exhibits.

stops.name: Singapore Botanic Gardens
stops.tips: UNESCO-listed gardens; the Orchid Garden costs 15 SGD, and mornings are cooler.

stops.name: Henderson Waves
stops.tips: The undulating wooden bridge of the Southern Ridges; a forest-canopy walk leads on to Mount Faber.

stops.name: Mount Faber Peak
stops.tips: Views of the harbour and Sentosa from the hilltop; the cable car station is here.

stops.name: VivoCity Food Republic
stops.tips: Food court in the HarbourFront mall; air-conditioned.

stops.name: Labrador Nature Reserve
stops.tips: Coastal nature park with war relics and mangroves.

backups.name: MacRitchie TreeTop Walk
backups.tips: Forest walk with a suspension bridge (3 hours); an alternative to the Southern Ridges.

stops.name: Changi Point Ferry Terminal
stops.tips: Bumboats leave once 12 people are aboard, 4 SGD; the crossing takes 10 minutes.

stops.name: Pulau Ubin Village Bicycle Rental
stops.tips: Bikes at the island entrance cost 10 SGD a day; this is Singapore's 1960s village.

stops.name: Chek Jawa Wetlands
stops.tips: Mangrove boardwalk and tidal flat; look out for wild boar and monkeys.

stops.name: Pulau Ubin Seafood Restaurant
stops.tips: Seafood at the village jetty; simple.

stops.name: Changi Village Hawker Centre
stops.tips: Nasi lemak (coconut rice) on the way back at Changi Village.

backups.name: Puaka Hill Pulau Ubin
backups.tips: The island's hilltop, with views over the quarry lake.

backups.name: Cheong Lian Yuen Restaurant Pulau Ubin
backups.tips: Seafood in the island village; a fallback if the other restaurant is full.

stops.name: National Gallery Singapore
stops.tips: Southeast Asian art in the former City Hall and Supreme Court buildings; rooftop terrace.

stops.name: Boat Quay
stops.tips: Riverside shophouses; walk on to the Merlion.

stops.name: Merlion Park
stops.tips: The lion-fish statue, with a farewell photo against the Marina Bay view.

stops.name: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh Clarke Quay
stops.tips: Peppery pork rib soup for a farewell lunch.

stops.name: Changi Airport Jewel
stops.tips: The world's tallest indoor waterfall; a mall to explore before your flight.

backups.name: Amoy Street Food Centre
backups.tips: Hawker centre in the CBD; an alternative to bak kut teh.

backups.name: Asian Civilisations Museum
backups.tips: Riverside museum; an alternative to the gallery.
